origin.description: A character string is parsed by the default method. An Rconcordance object is returned as it is.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A concordance string or an Rconcordance object.

origin.details: The sample comment expands to 25 source lines in Sample.Rmd. Line 20 of the output is source line 25.
origin.example:
registerS3method("as.Rconcordance", "default", get("as.Rconcordance.default", asNamespace("backports")), envir = asNamespace("backports"))
bp_as.Rconcordance <- getFromNamespace("as.Rconcordance", "backports")
obj <- bp_as.Rconcordance("<!-- concordance::Sample.Rmd:1 9 1 1 6 14 1 -->")
cat(obj$srcFile, length(obj$srcLine), obj$srcLine[20], "\n")
